mentions.name: Canine
mentions.description: An open-source platform-as-a-service that serves as a full Heroku replacement, providing a web UI and CLI on top of a Kubernetes backend for deploying and running applications.
mentions.problem: Heroku was delightful but annoyingly locked-in and expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt:
It’s a basically a full Heroku replacement, with a UI, CLI, etc, except running with a Kubernetes backend.

It’s fully open source.
